description: Each template's equipment parts; a part with no row is all zeros.

columns.name: enemy
columns.description: the template

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: part
columns.description: weapon.blade, weapon.grip, weapon.gem1-3, shield.base, shield.gem1-3, accessory or limb0-5.armor

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: the global item id, which names the part

columns.name: sub_id
columns.description: the item's 1-based index in its family: item_id less 0 for a blade, 95 for a grip, 126 for a shield, armour or accessory, 260 for a gem

columns.name: weapon_model_id
columns.description: a blade's or shield's WEP model (OBJ/<two hex digits>.WEP, converted to models/weapons/<two hex digits>.gltf); 0 for other parts

columns.name: category
columns.description: a blade's category (1 dagger .. 9 crossbow), which with a model also picks the enemy's attack animations; a grip's type (1-4); an armour piece's (1 shield, 2 helm, 3 breast armour, 4 leggings, 5 glove, 7 accessory); 0 for a gem

columns.name: strength
columns.description: strength the part adds; a weapon sums its blade, grip and gems, a shield its base and gems

columns.name: intelligence
columns.description: intelligence the part adds; summed as strength

columns.name: agility
columns.description: agility the part adds; summed as strength

columns.name: current_dp
columns.description: current DP (equal to max_dp on the disc)

columns.name: max_dp
columns.description: maximum DP of a blade, shield or armour piece

columns.name: current_pp
columns.description: current PP (zero on the disc)

columns.name: max_pp
columns.description: maximum PP of a blade or shield

columns.name: damage_type
columns.description: the blade's damage type

columns.name: cost_type
columns.description: the resource the blade's base attack costs

columns.name: cost
columns.description: how much each of the blade's attacks costs

columns.name: material
columns.description: the part's material (zero on the disc: templates keep weapon, shield and armour materials in their own columns)

columns.name: recovery_delay
columns.description: the blade's recovery delay: after an action that takes the weapon's delay, the wielder waits (this + the enemy's recovery_delay_bonus) * 256 / 35 battle updates to act again

columns.name: gem_slots
columns.description: how many gems a grip or shield holds

columns.name: gem_effects
columns.description: a gem's effect (0 none). In a weapon: 1/2 +20 points of physical/spell hit chance, 3/4 +5% physical/spell damage. In a shield: 5/6 -20 points to physical/spell hits on the holder, 7/8 -5% physical/spell damage taken, and 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19 and 21 -20 points to hits that apply strength-down, intelligence-down, agility-down, legs-impaired, silence, paralysis, poison and numbness. 9: a weapon gains 5% more PP a physical hit, a shield 5% less. Hit-chance gems need the weapon drawn

columns.name: range
columns.description: the blade's horizontal x extent, 32 world units a step; the enemy's reach is added to it and to the other two extents

columns.name: range_y
columns.description: the blade's vertical extent, 32 world units a step (the vertical radius of the ellipsoid the base attacks use)

columns.name: range_z
columns.description: the blade's horizontal z extent, 32 world units a step

columns.name: attack_shape
columns.description: the volume shape stored with the blade; targeting ignores it (an attack takes the action's range_shape, ellipsoid for the base attacks), and every disc blade holds ellipsoid

columns.name: attack_angle
columns.description: the attack volume's pitch, in 11.25-degree steps (1/32 turn)

columns.name: type_none
columns.description: signed rating against hits of this type: a grip's, for its blade's type, and an accessory's add 1% attack per 4 points; armour's, a shield's and an accessory's add 1% defense per point

columns.name: type_blunt
columns.description: signed rating against hits of this type: a grip's, for its blade's type, and an accessory's add 1% attack per 4 points; armour's, a shield's and an accessory's add 1% defense per point
